The '''RC Battle Ground''' is a small RC battle arena that is seen in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. 

==Description==
The battleground is referred to as "No Man's Land" by [[Zero]]. The field serves as the location for the mission [[New Model Army]]. The objective of the mission is to escort Zero's RC vehicle to [[Berkley|Berkley's]] base while piloting an [[RC Goblin]], and to destroy all of Berkley's defenses. The Battle Ground looks like it is located in an attic or an old warehouse; its actual location is never revealed though it's presumed to be somewhere in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]]. The interior is only accessible to the player during the aforementioned mission, or through cheats or [[modifications]]. It can also be accessed through the [[Hidden Interiors Universe|Interiors Universe]]. It is mostly made up of wood, artificial terrain, and both Zero's and Berkley's bases. Interestingly, the texture of the river criss-crossing through the arena shares the same texture with the water of [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City|GTA Vice City]].
